technical.summary: Bullish momentum with strong short-term confluence (Hull flip, AO cross, three white soldiers) but overbought conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit conviction; suitable for swing entry only with tight stops given extended stochastic levels.

fundamental.summary: AMP shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying engagement, minimal retail interest, and earnings arriving in 91 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no conviction signal; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (299.68), and negative macro score (-4) create hostile trading environment; earnings in 91 days poses minimal near-term binary risk but overall conditions are extremely unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical confluence (Hull flip, AO cross, three white soldiers, price above all MAs) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (31/100) offers tactical swing entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum (stoch, stochRSI, Williams %R), weak ADX trend strength, inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (299.68), zero fundamental conviction, and no active strategy triggers create hostile macro environment that overwhelms short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong short-term technical confluence (Hull flip, AO cross, three white soldiers) with contrarian opportunity in extreme fear zone offers tactical setup. However, overbought momentum and weak trend strength require confirmation of pullback hold before committing capital.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (299.68), inverted yield curve, and macro deterioration create hostile environment that can reverse short-term technicals rapidly; overbought conditions (stoch, stochRSI, Williams %R) signal pullback risk before swing target.
